easyPrerequisites:
Nissa, Vital Force has at least one loyalty counter.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping Grove of the Burnwillows and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste until your next turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
